description: This file implements classes and functions related to internal DNS host resolution results, including serialization/deserialization, handling different result types (data, metadata, error, alias), and managing associated metadata and endpoints.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult
classes.description: Base class representing an internal DNS resolution result, with subclasses for specific result types.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResult
classes.description: Represents a successful DNS data result containing endpoints, strings, and hosts.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResult
classes.description: Represents metadata associated with DNS results, including priority and connection metadata.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Represents an error result with an associated error code.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
classes.description: Represents an alias result pointing to another domain name.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Creates a specific result object from a base value, deserializing JSON data.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the result object into a base::Value for storage or transmission.

methods.name: AsData
methods.description: Returns the object as a data result type, with runtime check.

methods.name: AsMetadata
methods.description: Returns the object as a metadata result type, with runtime check.

methods.name: AsError
methods.description: Returns the object as an error result type, with runtime check.

methods.name: AsAlias
methods.description: Returns the object as an alias result type, with runtime check.
